title: fix: restore product path charts
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Keeps the partitioned `time` fields and the selected numeric series in all three product-path charts.
- Fixes “Data is missing a number field” for Paid Pollen, Quest Pollen, and Requests.
- Leaves Tinybird queries and every other dashboard unchanged.

Root cause: Grafana labels fields after `partitionByValues`, while the exact field filter discarded the labeled numeric fields.

Validation:
- Rendered all three panels locally with four representative product paths.
- `npx biome check --write provisioning/dashboards/platform-usage-rebuild.json`
- `npm run check` (Wrangler dry run)
- `git diff --check`

gist.headline: The charts found their numbers
gist.blurb: Three product-path charts were briefly staring into the void after Grafana renamed their fields. The numeric pollen and request series are visible again, as nature intended.
gist.summary: Restored the labeled numeric series and partitioned time fields in the Paid Pollen, Quest Pollen, and Requests product-path Grafana charts, fixing the “Data is missing a number field” panel error.
gist.impact: Operations contributors can again inspect Paid Pollen, Quest Pollen, and Requests across product paths without changing Tinybird queries or other dashboard panels.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy observability garden where three retro dashboard panels have recovered their missing number sprouts: Paid Pollen, Quest Pollen, and Requests. Polli, wearing tiny analyst glasses, carefully reconnects labeled chart lines to glowing numeric flowers while a helpful CRT monitor robot watches the graphs bloom.
